Stocks to Watch, 15 Sept: Stocks like Horizon Industrial Parks, Lalithaa Jewellery Mart, HDFC Bank, Solar Industries India, KEC International, Indiabulls, Strides Pharma Science, Dr Reddys Laboratories, Aurobindo Pharma, and Sun Pharmaceutical Industries will be in focus on September 15, 2026.   September 15, 2026 / 00:04 IST             Let's catch up on the latest news from the stock market. From significant investments to major deals, quarterly earnings, acquisitions, and order wins, here’s a quick look at which stocks will be in focus in today's trade: Sunshine Pictures will announce its quarterly earnings scorecard today. Horizon Industrial Parks  Q1 (Consolidated YoY) Loss narrows to Rs 10.3 crore Vs loss of Rs 64.3 crore Revenue grows 23.1% to Rs 200.5 crore Vs Rs 162.9 crore Lalithaa Jewellery Mart  Q1 (Consolidated YoY) Profit falls 21.6% to Rs 208.2 crore Vs Rs 265.6 crore Revenue jumps 26% to Rs 6,031.2 crore Vs Rs 4,786.1 crore Nova Iron & Steel  Q1 (YoY) Profit plunges 61.1% to Rs 0.86 crore Vs Rs 2.2 crore Revenue sinks 40.3% to Rs 67.5 crore Vs Rs 113 crore Stocks to Watch The Board members have approved the appointment of the Managing Director & Chief Executive Officer of HDFC Bank by submitting the names of two candidates in order of preference, along with the remuneration proposed to be paid to them, for a period of three years, subject to approval from the RBI. The Board also approved the re-appointment of V Srinivasa Rangan and Jimmy Tata as Whole-time Directors (designated as Executive Directors) of the Bank for a period of three years. Further, the Board has approved the creation of one additional position of Whole-time Director, thereby increasing the strength of Whole-time Directors to four, in addition to the Managing Director & Chief Executive Officer. The company's subsidiary, Solar SA Investments Proprietary, has signed definitive agreements with Omnia Holdings, an international diversified group providing innovative products, solutions and specialised services to the mining and agriculture sectors, for the acquisition of all outstanding shares of Omnia for US$1.355 billion (Rs 12,951 crore). The company has secured new orders worth Rs 1,303 crore for transmission & distribution projects across India, the Middle East and the Americas. With these orders, its year-to-date order intake has risen to over Rs 7,600 crore. The company has executed a definitive agreement with Fintech Cloud, which provides technology-enabled solutions and support for origination, underwriting and servicing to NBFCs, to acquire a 70% stake for Rs 1,050 crore by way of an NCLT Scheme. The company has executed a Joint Venture Agreement with Drydocks World Dubai – FZCO (DDW) on the sidelines of the BRICS Summit 2026 in New Delhi. The United States Food and Drug Administration (USFDA) conducted a routine current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) inspection at the company's formulations facility in Alathur, Chennai, during the period from September 2 to September 11, 2026. Following the inspection, the USFDA issued a Form 483 with three observations. The US FDA has completed a records assessment at the company's API manufacturing facility in Mexico and issued a Form FDA 2953 containing two observations. The assessment was conducted between July 17 and September 8, 2026. The United States Food and Drug Administration (US FDA) inspected Unit-IV, an API manufacturing facility of the company's subsidiary Apitoria Pharma, in Srikakulam, Andhra Pradesh, from September 7 to September 11, 2026. The inspection concluded with zero observations. The company's subsidiaries, Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Inc, Taro Pharmaceutical Industries and Taro Pharmaceuticals USA Inc, have signed a settlement agreement with a plaintiff in the In re Generic Pharmaceuticals Pricing Antitrust Litigation in Pennsylvania, US, for a confidential amount. Under the terms of the settlement agreement, the subsidiaries will make the settlement payment in exchange for a full release of all claims asserted against them in this action. Other terms of the settlement remain confidential. The settlement agreement was entered into without any admission of wrongdoing in the action. Jubilant Pharmova said the USFDA has concluded its review of the Establishment Inspection Report (EIR) for the inspection conducted at Jubilant HollisterStier LLC's CMO facility in Spokane, Washington, from June 8 to June 17, 2026, and has classified the facility as Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI). Jubilant HollisterStier LLC is a subsidiary of Jubilant Pharma Holding Inc., which is a subsidiary of Jubilant Pharma, Singapore, a wholly owned subsidiary of the company. The company announced a proposed capital restructuring of its joint venture (JV) company, Greenply Samet, paving the way for a greater focus on accelerating the growth and expansion of its core plywood and medium-density fibreboard (MDF) businesses. Under the preliminary terms of the proposed restructuring, the JV partner, Samet, will invest additional capital of $30-40 million into the JV entity over the next two to three years. During the quarter, the company's aerospace subsidiary secured significant new aerospace business from a leading Indian aerospace and defence major. The award covers more than 300 part numbers — precision-machined, casting and structural — across multiple aircraft applications, with annual volumes exceeding 37,000 components. At expected production rates, this represents an annual business potential of approximately Rs 33 crore. The company launched its expanded TVS Apache motorcycle portfolio in Sri Lanka, comprising the flagship TVS Apache RR 310, TVS Apache RTR 310, TVS Apache RTR 200 4V TFT and TVS Apache RTR 160 4V TFT. DK Singh has resigned as Non-Executive Independent Director and Chairperson of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee (NRC) with immediate effect. The Board has reconstituted the NRC and Stakeholders' Relationship Committee (SRC) and designated Beth Boucher, Non-Executive Independent Director, as the Chairperson of the NRC. Moody’s Ratings has upgraded Piramal Finance's Long-Term Corporate Family Rating (CFR) and Senior Secured Debt Rating to Ba2 from Ba3, reflecting the continued improvement in the company's financial and risk profile, with a stable outlook. Himanshu Agarwal has joined the company as Chief Financial Officer and Additional Director with effect from September 17. Ambarish Raghuvanshi's tenure as Interim CFO and KMP of the company will conclude with effect from September 16. The company has received an appeal order from the Commissioner (Appeals-III), CGST and Central Excise, Mumbai, Maharashtra, in 2026, confirming the total GST demand, including interest and penalty, of Rs 3,365.15 crore. The appeal order will have no material adverse impact on the financial operations of the company, and the same will be further contested by way of an appeal before the GST Appellate Tribunal, the company said. The company has filed an application in Form RSC-1 with the National Company Law Tribunal, Bengaluru, seeking sanction of the proposed reduction of share capital. The proposed reduction involves utilisation of Rs 2,050.16 crore out of the balance of Rs 2,158.9 crore standing to the credit of the Securities Premium Account of the company to fully set off its accumulated losses amounting to Rs 2,050.16 crore as of March 2026, thereby eliminating such losses from its books of account and presenting a true and fair view of its financial position. Bulk & Block Deals Market veteran Sunil Singhania's Abakkus Investment Managers acquired 27 lakh shares, representing a 1.48 percent stake in BlackBuck, from Accel India IV (Mauritius) for Rs 155.5 crore. The shares changed hands at Rs 576.05 apiece. Accel India IV held a 7.17 percent stake, or 1.3 crore equity shares, in BlackBuck as of June 2026, according to the company's shareholding pattern. Promoters Randeep Singh Jauhar and Pradeep Singh Jauhar each sold 99.95 lakh shares, representing a 2.5 percent stake, in Jamna Auto Industries. The total stake sold was worth Rs 255.87 crore at a price of Rs 128 per share. On the other side, three institutional investors acquired the entire stake sold by the Jamna Auto promoters. 360 ONE Mutual Fund and 360 ONE Asset Management acquired 99.95 lakh shares, or a 2.5 percent stake, in Jamna Auto for Rs 127.93 crore. DSP Mutual Fund picked up 78.12 lakh shares, representing a 1.95 percent stake, for Rs 100 crore, while the Abu Dhabi Investment Authority acquired 21.82 lakh shares, or a 0.54 percent stake, for Rs 27.93 crore. Promoter Krishna Prasad Chigurupati sold 1.33 crore equity shares, representing a 5.36 percent stake in Granules India, at Rs 872.50 per share, valued at Rs 1,160 crore. Krishna Prasad Chigurupati also pared another 39.04 lakh shares, or a 1.57 percent stake, for Rs 348.64 crore at Rs 892.84 per share. In total, the promoter sold shares worth Rs 1,508.64 crore, reducing his stake in the company by 6.94 percent. On the other side, Capital Group, Kotak Mahindra Life Insurance Company, 360 ONE Pipe Fund, SBI Life Insurance Company, Aditya Birla Sun Life Mutual Fund, Jagdish Naresh Master, Myraa Varun Raheja, Sundaram MF, BNP Paribas Financial Markets, Buoyant Opportunities Strategy-III, Clarus Capital 1, Edelweiss MF, Emerging Markets Equity Fund, Florida Retirement System, Goldman Sachs Bank Europe and Optimix Wholesale Global Emerging Markets Share Trust acquired 5.36 percent stake in Granules India. Sri Lotus Developers and Realty Morgan Stanley Asia Singapore Pte acquired 15 lakh shares, representing a 0.3 percent stake in Sri Lotus Developers and Realty, from Mohamed Irfan Mohamed Latif Shaikh for Rs 30.26 crore at Rs 201.75 per share. Promoter entity Trilochan Singh Sahney Trust 1 sold 5 lakh shares, representing a 0.51 percent stake in NRB Bearings for Rs 25.25 crore. The shares changed hands at a price of Rs 505 per share. DT Fund was the biggest buyer among the three investors, picking up 2.27 lakh shares in NRB Bearings for Rs 11.49 crore. GP Emerging Markets Strategies LP acquired 1.11 lakh shares for Rs 5.64 crore, while University of Notre Dame DU Lac bought 1.6 lakh shares for Rs 8.1 crore. Radiant Global Fund-Class B Participating Shares acquired an additional 2.15 lakh shares, equivalent to a 1.69 percent stake in Electrotherm (India), from 8 Square Capital for Rs 20.53 crore. The shares changed hands at Rs 951.83 apiece. As of June 2026, Radiant Global Fund-Class B Participating Shares held a 1.41 percent stake in Electrotherm (India), while 8 Square Capital held a 2.32 percent stake.
